product: Ravenloft: Strahd's Possession — faithful full native original-game recreation

stages.label: Internal continuous-original-game acceptance
stages.scope: One real continuously playable normal launch through all authored Level 22 systems and its genuine frame-20 Level23 loader boundary; not a standalone Level22 product.

gates.name: Original cold start, menus and character creation
gates.pass_when: CINE/title and every original menu choice function or clearly documented source-exact unavailable behavior; CODE.1 creation naturally reaches CODE.2 gameplay via CHARS.
blocked_by: Unimplemented menu options 0/1, incomplete normal startup field verification.

gates.name: CHARS handoff and original existing-party start
gates.pass_when: New and existing party paths preserve exact 0x920 CHARS, actor/equipment bytes, supervisor ordering and party world initialization in ordinary launch.
blocked_by: Disk handoff passes Windows regression but has not been field-/DOS-compared.

gates.name: Initial and traversed Level22 3D/HUD VGA
gates.pass_when: Correct original palette, scene geometry, floor/ceiling, walls, sprites, occlusion and UI under ordinary play including source depth-dependent FF50.
blocked_by: Source depth/FF50/ES writes and full DOS indexed-frame comparison remain unaccepted.

gates.name: Movement, collisions, interaction and clocks
gates.pass_when: Original keyboard/mouse and IRQ cadence drive movement, collision, doors, automap, pickups and menu hitboxes from normal startup.
blocked_by: Win32 scan stream not source-proven bridged to F590/F572 original IRQ.

gates.name: Level22 combat, NPC reaction and AI
gates.pass_when: Player combat, original Assassin behavior/death and four authored drops work in ordinary game path with original dice, order, state and timing.
blocked_by: Original full combat/AI/cadence interaction remains unaccepted.

gates.name: Inventory and essential spell/rest controls
gates.pass_when: Normal Level22 game includes source-correct pickup, cursor, equipment, usable items, menus and source-available essential spell/rest functions without dev actions.
blocked_by: Unfinished original item use, spells, rest and overlay actions.

gates.name: All-relic Level22 story and original exit
gates.pass_when: Original four-relic predicate and quest action play the 22-frame mist sequence and frame-20 level-23 load with persistent party/world state.
blocked_by: Story mist and original frame-20 live event/transition unaccepted.

gates.name: Original initial audio/video chronology
gates.pass_when: CINEx, original title/game music, effects, palette fades and milestone-specific pacing match DOS for the accepted route.
blocked_by: Original source audio, presentation and timing comparison incomplete.

gates.name: Reproducible exact-source full Windows CI
gates.pass_when: On the Alpha candidate SHA, clean Full Windows compile, all CTests, recorded EXE hash and original-free artifact succeed with no test skips affecting accepted path.
blocked_by: Historical Full #667 passes, but no accepted Alpha candidate SHA/field run exists.

gates.name: Owner field and independent DOS acceptance
gates.pass_when: Owner accepts a protected-copy normal Windows play session and matched original DOS state/frames/ticks for the entire Alpha route.
blocked_by: No accepted normal-route, original-DOS comparative Level22 field session.

stages.label: Complete original campaign playable
stages.scope: The same Alpha engine runs all original authored story routes from startup to real ending, including save/load. Remaining fidelity differences explicitly tracked and non-blocking.

gates.name: Real startup-to-ending original campaign
gates.pass_when: Playable actual original progression via authored triggers/levels with continuous party/world data; final original ending without cheats, skip controls or synthetic transitions.
blocked_by: Original all-level story event graph/end-to-end route unimplemented and untested.

gates.name: All original levels and transitions
gates.pass_when: All relevant authored level records/cells, gates, objects, script events, world changes and returns from original data work in story order.
blocked_by: General level loader does not establish source event-driven exits or campaign completion.

gates.name: Complete game rules and stats
gates.pass_when: Source-equivalent party creation/progression, equipment, conditions, rests, time, inventory, NPC combat, resource rules and UI functionality work across campaign.
blocked_by: Cross-level original gameplay mechanics incomplete.

gates.name: Complete original magic system
gates.pass_when: Original spell books, casting/prayer/memorization, durations, effects, resistances, targets and leveling rules work on authored campaign routes.
blocked_by: Original live magic/rest system incomplete.

gates.name: All relevant enemy/NPC behaviors
gates.pass_when: Monster/actor AI, conditions, combat, movement, encounters and death/reward state operate at original tick/rng order in every visited level.
blocked_by: AI/timing/encounter acceptance incomplete.

gates.name: Whole-world save and load round-trip
gates.pass_when: Exact compatible original party and world persistence survives exit, level changes, reloads and changed world inventory/events without losing state.
blocked_by: Current SAVE/LOAD subsystem is partial; complete mutable-world round-trip unavailable.

gates.name: All original presentation and sound assets
gates.pass_when: All original world surfaces, RES animations, CINE/music/sfx and relevant overlays route through source-authentic render/audio systems without placeholder substitutes.
blocked_by: Original compositing and sound dispatch incomplete.

gates.name: Original option/input/error paths
gates.pass_when: All original menu choices, normal setup, in-game options, keyboard/mouse, cancellation and recoverable failures work with unchanged original semantics.
blocked_by: Unfinished menu options and DOS IRQ input bridge.

gates.name: Full Windows Beta candidate and regression
gates.pass_when: All reconstructed gameplay/serialization/presentation CTests pass on exact candidate Windows SHA; successful protected-copy all-game field logs and original-media integrity manifest.
blocked_by: No complete campaign candidate or full-game regression/field evidence.

gates.name: All material blockers cleared
gates.pass_when: No known reproducible blocker prevents original campaign completion or corrupts user saves; residual fidelity mismatches tracked with original evidence and fix priority.
blocked_by: Critical campaign-blocking systems and original-DOS mismatches remain.

stages.label: Original-game faithful final release
stages.scope: The entire shipped DOS game's behavior, authentic data and presentation are accepted in the native executable; no game-facing modernization is incorporated.

gates.name: Gameplay state/rules parity
gates.pass_when: Across original campaign and representative edge branches, movement, combat, magic, RNG, AI, scripts and all mutable global state compare equal to original DOS.
blocked_by: Original full gameplay/state differential acceptance unavailable.

gates.name: Indexed VGA, palette and animation parity
gates.pass_when: Original pixels/page masks/overdraw, texture span/occlusion, modal UI, fades, text and cinematic frame/palette chronology match supported DOS capture cases.
blocked_by: Indexed VGA depth and ES/video selector callbacks still unverified.

gates.name: Original interrupts, inputs and time parity
gates.pass_when: Keyboard/mouse event services, port/IRQ/BIOS/PIT timing, animation dwell, RNG call ordering and clock state match original in supported conditions.
blocked_by: IRQ/clock/input cross-runtime traces unaccepted.

gates.name: Original music/effects parity
gates.pass_when: Original music driver tracks, event effects, trigger ordering, mixing and supported device behavior are accepted against original capture.
blocked_by: Original audio device/mix/timing equivalence unresolved.

gates.name: Original save/state compatibility
gates.pass_when: Create, restore, migrate if explicitly supported, exit and reenter original games preserving format and mutable world flags at all tested points.
blocked_by: Full-world compatible SAVE/LOAD not accepted.

gates.name: All original content and ending branches
gates.pass_when: All relevant original levels, endings, scripted event paths, menu/input branches, spells/items and patch-variant scope have complete source/evidence coverage.
blocked_by: Original campaign/endings and byte-verified content coverage incomplete.

gates.name: Quirks, edge cases, and absence of unfaithful substitutes
gates.pass_when: Known original quirks, relevant errors, odd event sequencing and supported missing-resource behavior are preserved; no invented game behavior or standalone-dev shortcuts.
blocked_by: Original errors and side effects not exhaustively accepted.

gates.name: Reproducible clean final signed-off native build
gates.pass_when: A pinned Full Windows clean build, CTests, runtime smoke, source/asset integrity checks, artifact hash, supported install paths and safe save handling pass.
blocked_by: Final source candidate and independently audited package do not exist.

gates.name: Release evidence and licensing preservation
gates.pass_when: Game assets never embedded in public source/artifact, user-supplied original install supported, licensing/provenance, known version and user instructions verified.
blocked_by: Final owner-media installation and packaging acceptance pending.

gates.name: Complete-game original fidelity owner acceptance
gates.pass_when: Owner accepts replayable normal startup-to-ending field and DOS differential report and closes all material original-game fidelity gaps.
blocked_by: No complete DOS-vs-native acceptance report/signoff.
